| Input | Result |
|-------|--------|
| 7481  | <V50>     |

## Code Example

```python
def <B50>(x):
    return <V50>

assert <B50>(7481) == <V50>
assert <B50>(-51) == <V50>
```

## Interactive Session


The function <B50> yields <V50> regardless of argument value.
